digest.component_or_area: test suite / Anthropic LLM provider integration
propositions: Three test cases in test_rp04_s4_llm_runtime_heldout.py replace anthropic.AsyncAnthropic with function-shaped test doubles before pydantic_ai.providers.anthropic is lazy-imported, causing TypeError at the provider's runtime TypeAlias union evaluation.
The defect is test-isolation order-dependency, not production auth validation: the provider's first import captures the patched function and fails on the union before rebar validation logic executes.

Test doubles must preserve the SDK symbol's class contract to prevent import-time TypeError; replacing functions with class-shaped doubles reaches the intended secret-free LLMConfigError without altering production validation semantics.

A child-process oracle in test_anthropic_lazy_import_isolation_heldout.py asserts provider-absent initial state and validates all three affected nodes reach the contractual redacted conflict error after the monkeypatch is applied as a class.
